questions.question: Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries Limited owes 2.98 rupees of loans for every rupee of its owners' money. Which is closest to the truth?

choices.text: Its loans are small to manageable next to what the owners have put in.
Its loans are heavy: lenders have more riding on it than its owners.
Loans never matter for a company that makes a profit.

questions.explanation: At 2.98 rupees of loans per rupee of owners' money, lenders have more riding on Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries Limited than its owners, and repayments are due even in bad years.

questions.question: Insiders paid ₹345.34 a share on average. You would pay ₹142. What does the gap mean?

questions.explanation: At 0.41x what insiders paid, you pay close to their price for Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries Limited: a good sign.
